title: Swear-Jar Cost by Place and Time
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swearjar:entry
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| stats count as swears, sum(amount) as cost by location hour
| sort - cost
description: Shows where and when the swear jar fills up fastest.
value: A playful metric still reveals genuine stress pockets, commute frustrations, or environments that grind you down.
implementation: Send each swear-jar event to `index=personal`; summarize counts and cost by location and hour.
visualization: Heat map of swear-jar cost by location and hour.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces where and when your swear jar grows fastest, which often points to the most stressful pockets of the day.
